description: Searches the fixed bank of 30 resolution actions by life area, by what felt off, by a keyword, or by a mix of those. Returns up to 30 matches in bank order, each with its area and feeling, plus the total number of matches, including when there are none. Use it to browse what the quiz can pick before running the full quiz with pick_resolution.

area.description: Optional filter: one life area: 'Body and health', 'Money', 'Home', 'Work', 'Family and friends', or 'Mind and calm'.

keyword.description: Optional: a plain word to match against action names, e.g. 'walk', 'meal', 'savings'.

limit.description: Optional: max results to return, 1 to 30. Default 10.

off.description: Optional filter: one feeling: drained, piled up, stuck, drifted, or alone.

name: search_resolutions
title: Search resolutions
